title: Guru Nanak Jayanti greeting
hook: Warm wishes on Guru Nanak Jayanti from all of us at Galvor.
caption:
Warm wishes on Guru Nanak Jayanti from all of us at Galvor.

Guru Nanak Dev Ji taught people to work honestly, share what they have and stay humble. Good words to carry into any working day.

Wishing you and your family peace and light this Gurpurab.
alt_text: Festive greeting on a violet background with a lamp: Happy Gurpurab. Honest work, shared with others. Wishing you peace and light. From all of us at Galvor.

slides.headline: Honest work, shared with others. Wishing you *peace and light.*
slides.sub: From all of us at Galvor.
